DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのメモ帳の大きさで、お悩みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble choosing the size of this notepad?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕事で外に出るので、ポケットへ入る物を探しています。雨の時にも記録したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ポケットに入るメモ帳を雨天の屋外作業記録へ使いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I go outdoors for work, so I am looking for one that fits in a pocket. I want to take notes when it rains too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a pocket-sized notepad for outdoor work notes in rainy weather. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは普通の紙のメモ帳です。水に強い製品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a notepad with ordinary paper. Are you looking for a water-resistant product?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。表紙がしっかりしているので、中の紙も雨に強いと思いかけていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 丈夫な表紙から中の紙も耐水と考えかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The cover is sturdy, so I almost assumed the paper inside would resist rain too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the sturdy cover almost led you to assume the paper inside was water-resistant. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この売場には、水に強いメモ帳は置いていません。屋外の記録に使えるかは、こちらの商品ではご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We do not stock water-resistant notepads in this department. We cannot advise that this product is suitable for taking notes outdoors.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、これを仕事用に買うのは見送ります。サイズだけ合っていても、使う環境に合うかが大事ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 耐水品の扱いがなく当商品の仕事用購入を見送ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will hold off buying this for work. Even if the size is right, whether it suits the environment where I use it matters.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hold off buying this product for work because no water-resistant notepads are stocked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 室内で使う分も必要でしたら、こちらはその用途でお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you need one for indoor use too, you can choose this for that purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 室内用は今持っています。今日は代わりに買わず、職場で使っている物の名前を確認して探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 室内用は所有済みで職場の製品名を確認して探すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I already have one for indoors. Rather than buy this as a substitute today, I will check the name of the product used at work and look for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to check the product name at work and search for it, since you already have a notepad for indoors. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品の名前や仕様が分かると、探す際に伝えやすくなりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Knowing the product name and specifications will make it easier to explain what you want when searching.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同僚に写真と商品名を聞きます。袋に入れれば作業中も必ず濡れないとは考えず、道具の選び方も職場で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同僚へ商品情報を尋ね収納だけで防水保証とせず職場の道具選択を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask a colleague for a photo and the product name. I will not assume that putting it in a bag guarantees it will stay dry during work, and I will discuss choosing equipment at work too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask a colleague for product information and discuss equipment choices at work without treating storage in a bag alone as a waterproof guarantee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご用途が確認できましたね。それでは、お仕事の準備を進めてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We have clarified your intended use. Please go ahead with your preparations for work. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の催しへの参加についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about taking part in a community event?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母語の歌を一曲歌ってみたいです。日本語で曲を紹介するのが難しいので、応募の前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母語の歌で催しに参加したく日本語の曲紹介を応募前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to try singing one song in my native language. Introducing it in Japanese is difficult, so I would like to discuss it before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to participate with a song in your native language and discuss introducing it in Japanese before applying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、どのような歌をお考えなのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please tell me what sort of song you have in mind.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族から教わった歌です。歌詞を一行ずつ全部訳すより、家族との思い出があることを短く話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族から教わった歌の全訳より思い出を短く伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a song my family taught me. Rather than translating every line of the lyrics, I would like to briefly talk about the family memories associated with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to briefly share memories rather than fully translate the song your family taught you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出演できるかや紹介の時間は、催しの担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check with the event organizer about whether you can perform and how much time is available for the introduction.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私が歌う時間と、曲を紹介する時間も分けて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歌唱時間と紹介時間を分けて出演担当へ相談したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I would also like to discuss my singing time separately from the time for introducing the song.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to discuss singing time and introduction time separately with the performance organizer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紹介文の案はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a draft introduction?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「この歌を聞くと、家族と過ごした夕方を思い出します」と書きました。歌詞そのものの訳ではなく、私が選んだ理由です。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紹介案を示し歌詞訳ではなく選曲の本人の理由と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote, 'When I hear this song, I remember evenings spent with my family.' It is my reason for choosing the song, rather than a translation of the lyrics themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your draft introduction and explain that it gives your own reason for choosing the song, rather than translating the lyrics. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も担当へお伝えください。今の窓口では出演の決定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the organizer that preference too. This desk cannot decide whether you will perform.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。この短い紹介案と歌の長さを用意して問い合わせます。出演が決まるまでは、家族にもまだ相談中だと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紹介案と歌の長さで問い合わせ家族へも出演未決定と伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will prepare this brief introduction and the length of the song before inquiring. Until my appearance is confirmed, I will tell my family it is still being discussed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to inquire with the draft introduction and song length, and tell your family the appearance is not yet confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当との相談方法をご案内します。それでは、ご準備も楽しみながら進めてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will explain how to consult the organizer. Enjoy making your preparations. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお手紙を、本日差し出されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be posting this letter today?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に謝る手紙です。急いで出そうと思いましたが、言いたいことがきちんと書けたか気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人への謝罪文を急いで送る前に伝え方が気になると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a letter apologizing to a friend. I was going to send it quickly, but I am concerned whether I have properly written what I want to say.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before rushing to send an apology to a friend, ask about your concern over how you express it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封はまだ閉じていないのですね。内容を確認されてからお出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not sealed it yet, correct? Would you like to check the contents before sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。謝る言葉だけで、相手が困ったことについて何も書いていないと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 謝罪語だけで相手の困り事を書いていないと気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I realized it only contains words of apology and says nothing about the difficulties the other person experienced.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you realized you wrote only words of apology without mentioning the other person's difficulties. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容はご自身でお考えください。窓口では、文章が相手にどう伝わるかの判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consider the contents yourself. At the counter, we cannot judge how your writing will come across to the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。職員の方に読んで決めてもらうのでなく、自分の言葉で直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口へ文章評価を任せず本人の言葉で直したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Rather than asking a staff member to read it and decide for me, I would like to revise it in my own words.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to revise it in your own words rather than leaving evaluation of the writing to the counter staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日はお持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you take it home today?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ち帰ります。すぐ返事がほしいという文もありますが、返事を急がせたいわけではないので考え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日は持ち帰り返事を急がせる文も考え直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. There is also a sentence saying I want a reply right away, but I do not mean to rush the reply, so I will reconsider it.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take it home today and reconsider the sentence that rushes a reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差し出される際は、中身を整えて封をし、宛先をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When posting it, put the contents in order, seal it and check the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で読み返してから封をします。早く届けることだけを優先せず、何を謝りたいかを自分で確かめて送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅で謝罪内容を読み返し封と宛先を整えて差し出すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will reread it at home before sealing it. Rather than only prioritizing quick delivery, I will check for myself what I want to apologize for before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to reread your apology at home, prepare the sealed letter and address, then post it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お手紙の準備ができましたらお持ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring the letter when it is ready. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お借入れのご相談ということでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Am I correct that you would like to discuss a loan?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。言葉を間違えたかもしれません。持ってきたお金を、自分の口座へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借入れではなく持参現金を本人の口座へ入れたいと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. I may have used the wrong word. I want to put the money I brought into my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct yourself: you want to put the cash you brought into your own account, rather than borrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様のお金を口座へ預ける、ご入金のご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You would like to deposit your money into your account, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。「借りる」ではなく「預ける」ですね。銀行からお金を受け取りたいのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 預けるという動詞を確認し銀行から受け取る希望ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It is 'deposit,' not 'borrow.' I do not want to receive money from the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the verb 'deposit' and clarify that you do not want to receive money from the bank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の口座への入金として、確認を進めます。口座が分かる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will proceed with checking a deposit into your own account. Do you have something that identifies the account?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この通帳があります。最初の言葉だけで別の申込みに進まず、入金の案内をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通帳を示し誤った動詞から別の申込みへ進まず入金案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have this bankbook. I would like guidance on a deposit, rather than proceeding with a different application based only on my first word.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your bankbook and request deposit guidance without proceeding to a different application because of the mistaken verb. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通帳を拝見します。今回、お持ちの現金をどのようにされたいか、もう一度確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will look at the bankbook. Please let me confirm again what you want to do with the cash you have brought today.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この現金を、こちらの通帳の口座に入れたいです。普段は母語で説明しているので、動きを言って確認できて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金と本人通帳を対応させ希望する動きを具体的に言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to put this cash into the account in this bankbook. I usually explain in my native language, so describing the movement of the money and checking it has helped.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the cash to your own bankbook and restate the intended movement specifically. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を確認できました。受付に必要なご案内をいたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have confirmed what you want. I will explain what is needed for the service.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。説明を聞いてから手続きをします。今後も動詞に迷ったら、お金をどこへ動かしたいか話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付説明後に手続きし動詞に迷う時はお金の移動を具体的に説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will follow the procedure after hearing the explanation. If I am unsure about a verb in future, I will explain where I want to move the money.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will follow the procedure after the service explanation and describe the movement of money specifically when unsure about a verb. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、分かりやすくお伝えいただけました。それでは、入金のお手続きへご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, you explained it clearly. I will now guide you through the deposit procedure. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 少しお疲れでしょうか。何かご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you a little tired? May I help you find something?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 亡くなった祖母のことを思い出して、涙が出てしまいました。人の通り道で立ち止まらず、少し静かに休める場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祖母を思い涙が出たため通路を空け静かに休める場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I remembered my late grandmother and started crying. Is there somewhere quiet to rest for a little while without stopping in people's path?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cried thinking of your grandmother and ask for a quiet resting place that leaves the passage clear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの休憩する場所をご案内します。まず、お足元を確かめてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will show you a resting place here. First, watch your step as you move forward.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今すぐ何かの儀式を申し込むつもりではなく、自分の気持ちを落ち着けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 儀式申込みではなくまず気持ちを落ち着けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I am not intending to apply for any ceremony right now; I want to calm my feelings.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you first want to calm your feelings, rather than apply for a ceremony. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。参拝の進み方が分からない時は、落ち着かれてからお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. If you are unsure how to proceed with worship, please ask once you feel calmer.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。家族へ電話していると声が大きくなりそうなので、今は携帯をしまって少し座ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 参拝案内は落ち着いてから尋ね今は携帯をしまい座ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. My voice might become loud if I call my family, so I will put my phone away and sit for a while now.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to ask about worship after calming down and put your phone away to sit now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご一緒にお越しになった方へ、休憩することはお伝えになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you tell the person who came with you that you are taking a break?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が先に見て回っています。ここで休んでいると短く連絡し、急いで戻ってもらう必要はないと伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行友人へ休憩場所を知らせ急いで戻る必要はないと伝えたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend is looking around ahead of me. I briefly contacted them to say I am resting here and told them they do not need to hurry back.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you told your accompanying friend where you are resting and that there is no need to hurry back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お連れ様にも居場所が伝わっていれば安心ですね。無理に先を急がずお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is reassuring that your companion knows where you are. Please take your time without forcing yourself to hurry onward.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少し落ち着いてきました。祖母の思い出を大切にしながら、分からないことは係の方に聞いて、ゆっくり参拝したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 落ち着いたことを伝え係へ不明点を尋ねながらゆっくり参拝すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am feeling a little calmer. While cherishing memories of my grandmother, I would like to worship slowly and ask the staff about anything I do not understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you feel calmer and will worship slowly while asking staff about anything unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご自身のペースでお過ごしください。それでは、静かな時間になりますように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take things at your own pace. I hope you have a peaceful time. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の中で、気になるところはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything in the exhibition that interests you?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族とテレビで競技を見た時のことを思い出しました。ルールは詳しくないのですが、見学しても楽しめますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 競技ルールに詳しくないが家族の応援の思い出から見学したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: It reminded me of watching a competition on television with my family. I do not know the rules well, but can I still enjoy visiting?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to visit because of memories of cheering with your family, despite not knowing the sport's rules well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご関心のある展示からご覧ください。思い出したのは、どのような場面でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please start with the displays that interest you. What kind of scene did you remember?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 選手が最後まで滑るのを、家族みんなで応援していました。競技の名前は覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族で滑る選手を応援したが競技名は記憶していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: My whole family was cheering the athlete on as they glided all the way to the end. I do not remember the name of the sport.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your family cheered an athlete as they glided, but you do not remember the sport's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前を思い出せなくても大丈夫です。こちらの説明で、競技名や道具を確かめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is fine if you cannot remember the name. You can check the sport's name and equipment in this explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず道具の説明を読みたいです。結果を全部覚えるより、あの時どんな気持ちで応援したかを思い出してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道具の説明から見て当時の気持ちも思い出したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to read about the equipment first. Rather than memorizing all the results, I will try remembering how I felt when cheering then.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to start with the equipment explanation and recall your feelings at the time too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明の中で分からない言葉がありましたら、お尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: If there are words in the explanation that you do not understand, please ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この道具の名前を読めません。読み方を聞いて、自分の見学メモへ書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道具名の読みを尋ね自分の見学メモへ書く許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot read the name of this equipment. May I ask how to pronounce it and write it in my own visit notes?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to pronounce the equipment's name and request permission to write it in your own visit notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身のメモへどうぞ。こちらの表示に沿って、読みをご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly, in your own notes. I will explain the pronunciation according to this display.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読み方を教わったら、道具をもう一度見ます。家族には、知っている競技の話だけでなく、今日初めて気づいたことも話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具を見直し新しく気づいたことも家族に話したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I learn the pronunciation, I will look at the equipment again. I want to tell my family not only about sports I already know, but also things I noticed for the first time today.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to look at the equipment again and tell your family about newly noticed things too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よい見学のお話になりそうですね。それでは、ご自身の関心に合わせてお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: It sounds as though you will have a good visit to talk about. Please enjoy it according to your own interests.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方と、ご一緒にお参りされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you worship together with your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同行者はお参りしますが、私は自分の信仰があるので参拝の動作はしません。静かに待てる場所を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人の信仰により参拝には加わらず同行者を静かに待つ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: My companion will worship, but I have my own faith, so I will not perform the worship gestures. Could you show me somewhere to wait quietly?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to wait quietly for your companion without joining worship because of your own faith. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お参りには加わらず、お連れの方をお待ちになるご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: You want to wait for your companion without taking part in worship, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。相手が大事にしていることは尊重したいです。ただ、同じ動作をする約束をして来たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者を尊重するが同じ動作をする合意はしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I want to respect what matters to them. But I did not come having promised to perform the same gestures.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you respect your companion but have not agreed to perform the same gestures. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通行の邪魔にならない待機場所をご案内します。お連れの方には、ご希望を伝えられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will show you a waiting place that does not obstruct people. Have you told your companion what you would like?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだなので、先に話します。怒って離れるのではなく、私は静かに待っていると伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別行動を怒りと受け取らせず本人の希望を同行者へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet, so I will talk to them first. I want to say that I am not walking away in anger; I will be waiting quietly.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will explain your preference to your companion so that being apart is not interpreted as anger. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待合せの場所を、お互いに確認しておくと安心ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be reassuring to confirm the meeting place with each other.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この案内の所で待つと決めました。参拝が終わったら来てもらい、途中で急ぐように電話はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共通の待合せ場所を決め参拝中に急かす連絡はしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: We decided I will wait by this information point. They will come after worship, and I will not phone them partway through to hurry them.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have agreed on a meeting place and will not contact them to hurry them during worship. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待ちの間にご案内が必要になりましたら、お声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need assistance while waiting, please let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分の希望を説明できたので、同行者の時間も大切にして待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望を説明できた礼を述べ同行者の時間も尊重して待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Since I could explain what I wanted, I will wait while respecting my companion's time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Thank them for helping you explain your preference and decide to wait while respecting your companion's time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お連れの方とごゆっくりお過ごしください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time with your companion. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メモをお持ちですね。ご相談の経過を書かれたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have some notes. Do they describe the course of the matter you want to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。自分の母語で書きました。このまま渡すだけでなく、私から日本語で順に説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母語の出来事メモを持参し本人が日本語で経過を説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote them in my native language. Rather than simply handing them over, I would like to explain events in order myself in Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought notes of events in your native language and want to explain the sequence yourself in Japanese. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、何があった時のメモかお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please tell me what happened that these notes concern.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰り道で知らない人に声を掛けられた時のことです。言われた言葉と、自分が怖かったという感想を同じ行に書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 知らない人の言葉と本人の怖さを同じ行に記したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was when a stranger spoke to me on my way home. I wrote what they said and my impression that I was frightened on the same line.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the stranger's words and your own fear on the same line. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手が実際に言った言葉から、分かる範囲で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will start with the words the person actually said, as far as you know them.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この部分が相手の言葉です。ただ、正確に聞き取れなかった所もあるので、全部が引用とは説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手の発言部分を示し聞取れなかった部分まで正確な引用としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: This part is their words. But there are also parts I did not hear accurately, so I will not describe all of it as a quotation.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point to the person's words without presenting the parts you could not hear as exact quotations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の気持ちについても、その後でお話しいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also tell us about your own feelings afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 怖く感じたのは私です。相手が何を考えていたかは分からないので、メモの感想を相手の発言にしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の感情と不明な相手の意図を区別すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was the one who felt frightened. I do not know what the other person was thinking, so I will avoid presenting my impressions in the notes as their words.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish your own feelings from the other person's unknown intentions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時刻や場所も、分かる範囲でお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell us the time and place as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この順で話します。日本語でうまく言えない部分は聞き返しながら、自分が覚えていることを説明します。原文のメモもそのまま残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻と場所を順に説明し日本語は聞き返しながら原文メモも保つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain in this order. For parts I cannot express well in Japanese, I will ask for clarification as I explain what I remember. I will keep my original notes unchanged too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the time and place in order, ask for clarification in Japanese as needed and retain the original notes too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、順にお伺いします。それでは、こちらの席へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will listen in order. Please come to this seat. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの薬についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the medicine you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上着のポケットに薬の袋を入れたまま洗濯しました。袋が濡れてしまったので、どう扱えばよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬袋を上着ごと洗濯して濡らし取扱いを相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I washed my jacket with the medicine bag still in its pocket. The bag got wet, so I would like to ask how to handle it.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the medicine bag got wet when washed inside your jacket and ask how to handle it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中の薬も濡れたかどうか、ご自身で確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you been able to check for yourself whether the medicine inside got wet too?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりません。外の袋は乾きかけていますが、内側まで大丈夫かは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外袋が乾きかけているが中身への影響は未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know. The outer bag is starting to dry, but I cannot judge whether the inside is all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the outer bag is starting to dry but the effect on the contents has not been checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乾いて見えることだけで決めず、薬剤師が状態を確認します。洗濯した後に使われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: The pharmacist will check its condition rather than deciding just because it looks dry. Have you used it since washing it?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使っていません。新しい袋に入れ替えて元どおりと思う前に、この状態で見てもらおうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 洗濯後は未使用で袋の入替えだけで済ませず現状確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. Before changing it into a new bag and thinking it was back to normal, I decided to have it checked in this condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not used it after washing and request a check of its current state rather than merely changing bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お薬の名前や、受け取った時の説明は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know the medicine's name or the explanation you received with it?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別に保管した説明の紙があります。濡れて読みにくい袋から名前を想像せず、こちらも一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別保管した薬の説明紙を示し不鮮明な袋の名称を推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the explanation sheet stored separately. Please look at this too, rather than guessing the name from the wet bag that is hard to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the separately stored medicine explanation sheet without guessing the name on the unclear bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 薬剤師へ、洗濯した経過と今の状態をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the pharmacist what happened in the wash and its current condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。家で中身を加工したり勝手に捨てたりせず、まず取扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人で加工や廃棄をせず薬剤師へ扱いを確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Rather than altering the contents at home or throwing them away on my own, I want to ask how to handle them first.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask the pharmacist how to handle it without altering or discarding it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、薬剤師がお話を伺います。それでは、そのままお持ちになってこちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: The pharmacist will hear your concerns. Keep it as it is and wait here, please. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 小さいボタンをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for small buttons?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で作った人形の服に付けたいです。小さければ何でも合うかと思いましたが、穴の大きさも見た方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自作人形服のボタンを小ささだけでなく穴との関係で選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to put them on clothes for a doll I made. I thought any small button would fit, but I should check the buttonhole size too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want buttons for homemade doll clothes, choosing in relation to the holes rather than small size alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 服そのものか、大きさが分かる見本はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the clothes themselves or a sample showing the size?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 穴をこの紙に写してきました。服は家にあるので、この見本と比べながら候補を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服は自宅で穴を写した紙を比較用に持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I traced the hole onto this paper. The clothes are at home, so I would like to compare candidates with this sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the clothes are at home and you brought paper with a traced hole for comparison. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの二種類を、紙の横に置いて比べていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can place these two types beside the paper to compare them.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 丸い方は穴より少し大きいです。細長い方は通りそうですが、外れやすくないか家で試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つの形の穴との違いを見て自宅での試着が必要と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: The round one is a little larger than the hole. The long narrow one looks as though it would pass through, but I want to try at home to see whether it comes undone too easily.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the two shapes with the hole and say you need to try them at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一度に全部の分を買わず、少ない個数で試すこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can try a small number rather than buy all the buttons at once.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず丸い方を二つ買います。服の穴を直せるかも考え、全部同じ物をまとめて買うのは後にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まず丸形二個を選び服の穴の調整も考えまとめ買いを保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy two round ones first. I will also consider whether I can adjust the holes in the clothes and leave buying all matching buttons for later.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose two round ones first, consider adjusting the holes in the clothes and hold off buying the whole set. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 丸い方を二つですね。色はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Two round ones, correct? Is this color all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この青色でお願いします。紙の見本は持ち帰り、家で服と合わせてから次の分を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青い丸形二個を指定し紙を回収して実物に合わせると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: This blue, please. I will take the paper sample home and choose the next ones after matching them with the actual clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify two round blue buttons and decide to take the paper back to compare with the actual clothes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、青い丸いボタンを二つで承ります。それでは、人形の服作りをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then that will be two round blue buttons. Enjoy making the doll's clothes.
